battle.name: 宋收復河、岷等州之戰
battle.theater: 河州、岷州（今甘肅臨夏、甘南一帶
battle.brief: 北宋熙寧六年，王韶率軍在西北邊地與吐蕃交戰，收復河、岷等州，並藉此拓展熙河路。戰事反映宋廷以邊軍進逼吐蕃控制區。同期已列裝的維京長斧（Dane axe）屬北歐重型雙刃步戰斧，供前排步兵破盾、砍殺及迎擊重裝目標。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 熙寧六年（西元1073年）的交戰，應按當時政治實力，而非近代國名來界定。北宋一方，是趙頊朝廷在西北邊軍體系下，由王韶以洮河安撫司、熙州一線的宋軍為核心，包含主攻部隊、沿邊蕃兵、分守古渭寨與新取堡寨的守軍，以及輸送軍糧和軍器的後隊。吐蕃一方，是河湟一帶以木征為核心的諸部武裝，堡寨與騎兵分布在河州、洮州、岷州及黃河、洮水上游。漢籍所稱「吐番」或「吐蕃」是宋人對這些軍政力量的總稱，不表示木征統治一個疆界清楚的單一國家。西夏掌握河西走廊，是北宋經略河湟時的外部壓力，但本役沒有可靠材料證明西夏軍直接參戰，故不列為交戰方。戰場可由古渭寨、今臨洮，經熙州、今景泰，指向河州、今臨夏，再分向洮州與岷州、今岷縣；地理上屬山地河谷、隘口與高原邊緣相接的地帶。雙方爭奪的是可屯兵、儲糧、銜接驛路的堡寨和州治，因此本役實為一組相互銜接的邊地據點戰役，而不是兩支近代式野戰軍在開闊平原上的一次總決戰。
countriesEn: The belligerents in 1073 should be defined by contemporary political power rather than by modern nation-state names. On the Northern Song side were the frontier troops of Emperor Zhao Xu’s government, centered on Wang Shao and the Song forces around the Tao River and Xizhou. They comprised the main striking force, frontier tribal soldiers, garrisons at Guwei and newly captured forts, and rear echelons carrying grain and military equipment. The opposing force consisted of the armed organizations of the Tibetan tribes in the Huangshui and Tao River region, centered on Muzheng, with forts and cavalry around Hezhou, Taozhou, and Minzhou. The Chinese records’ collective labels ‘Tubo’ or ‘Tufan’ did not mean that Muzheng ruled a single state with clearly defined borders. Western Xia controlled the Hexi Corridor and created the strategic pressure behind Song’s operations in the Huangshui region, but no reliable source proves that Xia troops fought in this campaign, so Western Xia is not treated as a belligerent. The theater can be mapped from Guwei near modern Lintao through Xizhou near modern Jingtai to Hezhou near modern Linxia, with branches toward Taozhou and Minzhou near modern Min County. It was a region where mountain valleys, passes, and the edge of the plateau met. The real object of the fighting was control of forts and prefectural seats that could quarter troops, store grain, and connect courier roads. The campaign therefore formed a connected series of frontier operations rather than one modern-style set-piece battle on an open plain.
people: 王韶是本役的實際統帥。他時任洮河安撫司都監，負責河湟方向軍事，早於正式出戰便選擇古渭寨與熙州作為軍隊支點，安排堡寨、軍糧及後隊，而不是率領全部兵力從京師一路長途進軍。他既擬定河州方向的主攻，也須決定分兵控制洮、岷道路的時機；史料雖反覆稱許其戰功，卻不能因此把每次登城都由他親自指揮。木征是宋籍所稱的吐蕃大首領，河湟諸部軍隊在其號令下抵抗宋軍，占有河州一線堡寨。河州戰敗後，他失去對部分州治與外圍堡寨的直接控制，但本人並未在1073年被擒，翌年才正式向宋廷歸降，所以不能把木征寫成在戰場上被宋軍消滅。宋神宗趙頊批准西北用兵並提供兵糧與設官權力；王安石主持的朝廷議政則構成本役持續推動的政治條件。關於宋軍偏師將領的姓名，現存記載並不一致，故不能為湮沒無聞者補造一串輝煌將佐名錄。
peopleEn: Wang Shao was the operational commander of the campaign. Serving in the post of Director of the Tao River Pacification Office, he had responsibility for military action in the Huangshui region. Before the main operation began, he had already selected Guwei and Xizhou as bases for troops, grain, and rear services, rather than leading one indivisible army all the way from the capital. He planned the principal advance toward Hezhou and also had to decide when to detach troops toward Taozhou and Minzhou. The later praises of his achievement do not justify claiming that he personally led every assault. Muzheng was the leader whom the Song records called the great chief of the Tibetans. Forces under his authority resisted Song in the Hehuang region and occupied fortified sites along the Hezhou approaches. After the defeat at Hezhou, he lost direct control over several prefectural seats and outer forts, but he was not captured in 1073. He made his formal submission to the Song court only in the following year, so the campaign cannot be described as his destruction in battle. Emperor Shenzong, Zhao Xu, authorized the northwestern operation and supplied troops, grain, and authority to establish offices. The political environment created by the court government under Wang Anshi made continued prosecution possible. The surviving records do not consistently preserve the names of Wang Shao’s subordinate commanders, and no roster of celebrated generals has been invented to fill that gap.
kits: 就1073年可以合理採用的裝備而言，宋軍遠程兵器包括普通弓箭與弩；神臂弓在慶曆年間已見於北宋軍器記載，威力大，適合在堡門、隘口和固定陣位壓制騎兵，但不便像普通弓那樣快速連射，故不應假設每名射手都持有神臂弓。弓使用箭，弩使用弩矢，兩類投射物及替換用件須分開補充。前線步兵配用長槍、環首刀與盾，披皮甲或鎖子甲；不同軍籍、庫給與作戰任務所配甲兵不必相同。營中另有帳幕、旗、鼓、號角、繩索及拒馬，供扎營、傳令與維持營陣所用。馬匹主要用於巡哨、傳令、追擊和軍資輸送，不能把宋軍描寫成以衝鋒為主的純騎兵。以上裝備均早於1073年，現存本役材料卻沒有逐件點算庫存，因此不能推算每支部隊的弓弩數量。吐蕃方面的漢文記錄較少，只能確認其有騎兵、弓箭、刀槍及皮甲防護，不能替其指定一種像宋式神臂弓的精確型號。本役也沒有火銃、火炮或其他火器的可證實使用記錄。
kitsEn: The equipment reasonably available to Song forces in 1073 included ordinary bows and crossbows. The powerful Shenbi crossbow was already recorded in Northern Song military equipment during the Qingli era. It was suited to suppressing cavalry from a fixed position at a fort gate or mountain pass, but it was not as convenient for rapid repeated shooting as an ordinary bow. Bows fired arrows, while crossbows fired bolts; these projectiles and their replacement parts had to be supplied separately. Front-line infantry carried long spears, ring-pommel sabers, and shields, and wore either leather or mail armor. Armor and equipment would not have been identical across every unit because of differences in registration, supply, and assignment. Camp equipment included tents, banners, drums, horns, ropes, and portable barriers used for camp organization, signaling, and the maintenance of positions. Horses were employed for scouting, message carrying, pursuit, and transport, so the Song force should not be portrayed as a cavalry army whose principal method was shock assault. All these items were in use before 1073, although the campaign records do not provide itemized inventories for each formation, and no exact count of bows or crossbows can be reconstructed. The Chinese records preserve fewer details of Tibetan equipment. They confirm mounted troops, bows and arrows, blades and spears, and leather protection, but they do not justify assigning the Tibetan force a precise Chinese-style crossbow model. There is also no reliable evidence that firearms or gunpowder artillery were used in this campaign.
tactics: 王韶的作戰分成接近、接戰、奪堡與分進四個層次。入春後，他沒有把所有兵力塞進一支狹長的縱隊，而是以古渭寨、熙州為兩個供應與出師支點，主隊沿通往河州的谷道推進，偏師分別控制通往洮州、岷州的道路。現存戰報只把熙寧六年四月河州主戰的結果記為宋軍取勝，沒有留下可核定的村名、陣地或逐營次序；依宋代戰術與當地地形所能作出的有限重建，是宋軍先以弩手在固定位置射擊，以弓箭手和持長槍、環首刀的步兵維持正面，騎兵放在兩翼負責封鎖退路與追擊，待吐蕃騎兵失去衝力後，再由弩陣、步兵和側翼騎兵合擊。這不是史書明載的每一步，實際陣形只能確定到此。河州城落入宋軍後，王韶沒有立即遠追木征，而是先控制城門、整修堡壁、分置守兵、儲存軍糧，再派後隊接續，把新奪得的堡寨變成下一段軍糧、箭矢與弩矢的供應點。偏師隨即向洮、岷方向奪取外圍堡寨；宋軍以弩箭壓制城頭，步卒逼近堡門，奪門後留軍駐守，並修復道路、驛站和通訊。這種逐堡接管使戰線得以延伸，也同步拉長補給。史料未證明本役使用火攻或火器，不能為求生動而加入火油、火銃之類場面；木征也未被在本役當場擒獲。
tacticsEn: Wang Shao’s operation had four connected phases: approach, field engagement, seizure of forts, and dispersed consolidation. After spring began, he did not place every soldier in one narrow column. Instead, Guwei and Xizhou served as separate supply and departure points. The main force advanced along the valley road toward Hezhou, while detached columns secured routes toward Taozhou and Minzhou. The surviving dispatches record the fourth lunar month of Xining 6 as a Song victory in the principal engagement near Hezhou, but they preserve no verifiable village name, position, or exact order of formations. A limited reconstruction based on Song tactics and the terrain places crossbowmen at fixed positions, ordinary archers and spearmen with ring-pommel sabers in the front, and cavalry on the wings to close escape routes and pursue. Once the Tibetan cavalry’s charge had spent its force, the fixed crossbow line, infantry, and mounted troops could converge against it. This is a cautious reconstruction rather than a step-by-step diagram preserved in the annals. After Hezhou fell, Wang Shao did not immediately pursue Muzheng across the plateau. He first secured the gates, repaired the walls, distributed garrisons, and stored grain. Rear units then took over, turning the newly captured fort into a supply point for grain, arrows, and crossbow bolts along the next section of the route. Detached forces moved toward Taozhou and Minzhou to take the outer forts. Crossbow fire covered the walls, infantry approached the gates, and troops remained to hold what had been captured. Roads, courier stations, and communications were then repaired. This fort-by-fort consolidation extended the line but also lengthened the supply system. No reliable evidence places a fire attack or firearm in this campaign, and Muzheng was not captured on the field.
data: 時間線可分為數段。熙寧五年（1072）前後，宋軍已控制熙州並設置堡寨，古渭寨與熙州遂成為1073年戰役的出發基地；部分總敘把後續州境清理併記於熙寧六年，因此熙州取得的確切日期不宜說死。熙寧六年春，宋軍完成兵員整頓與軍糧集中，主隊推向河州方向；四月，關於河州主戰的宋方奏報出現，記載宋軍取勝及相當數量的斬獲。五月前後，河州城與主要堡寨由宋軍接管，宋方開始留兵、設官及修整城防。同年夏秋，分向洮州與岷州的偏師分別奪取州治和外圍堡寨，現存《宋史》與《續資治通鑑長編》沒有留下逐日行程，個別堡寨又或記為「取」或「降」，所以能確定的是州級控制結果，不能虛構每日渡河點。從地理看，主要方向是由古渭寨、熙州通往河州，再以兩支偏師分向洮州和岷州；後隊沿既有驛路輸送軍糧、箭矢、弩矢、帳幕與其他軍器，每取得一座堡寨，前進基地便向外移一段。兵員方面，現存材料沒有經審核的宋軍總數；宋方奏報曾把木征可集之兵寫成十餘萬，顯然帶有誇大，不能當作實際作戰兵力。宋籍所記「斬首數千」是宋方概括奏報，也不能反推雙方實際死亡總數。「拓地二千餘里」同樣是當時行政估算，而非現代測量。熙寧七年，木征才正式率部向宋廷歸降，因此那一年是本役的直接後續，不應改寫成1073年的戰鬥。
dataEn: The chronology can be separated into several stages. Around Xining 5, or 1072, Song forces had already gained control of Xizhou and established fortified positions. Guwei and Xizhou consequently became the departure bases for the 1073 campaign. Some general narratives attach the subsequent consolidation of the surrounding prefectures to Xining 6, so the exact dating of the Xizhou operation cannot be stated too rigidly. In spring of Xining 6, the Song completed personnel and grain preparations and moved the main force toward Hezhou. In the fourth lunar month, a Song dispatch concerning the principal Hezhou engagement reported a victory and substantial captures. Around the fifth month, Song forces took control of Hezhou city and its principal forts, after which troops were stationed, officials appointed, and defenses repaired. During the summer and autumn of the same year, detached columns moved toward Taozhou and Minzhou and seized the prefectural seats and outer forts. The surviving Songshi and Xu Zizhi Tongjian Changbian do not preserve a day-by-day itinerary, and individual forts are sometimes described as taken by assault or accepted by submission. The prefectural outcome can therefore be stated, but no daily river-crossing point should be invented. Geographically, the main axis ran from Guwei and Xizhou toward Hezhou, with two detached directions leading to Taozhou and Minzhou. Rear units carried grain, arrows, crossbow bolts, tents, and other equipment along existing courier roads, and each newly captured fort became the next forward supply base. No audited total survives for the Song army. Some court dispatches enlarged Muzheng’s potential force to more than one hundred thousand, an obviously inflated figure rather than a verified battlefield strength. The recorded phrase ‘several thousand beheaded’ is a Song summary of claimed kills and cannot be converted into a combined death toll. The statement that more than 2,000 li of territory was opened is likewise an administrative estimate rather than a modern survey. Muzheng’s formal submission to the Song court came in Xining 7, the following year, and belongs to the immediate aftermath rather than to the fighting of 1073.
cause: 這場戰爭有三層直接原因。第一層是北宋的西北戰略：西夏掌握河西走廊，河湟則由吐蕃諸部與宋軍交錯控制；宋廷若能在渭州上游、古渭寨與河州之間建立連續堡寨，便可從南方側翼逼近西夏控制區，使西北軍路不再只依賴狹窄的關中通道。熙寧初年，王韶提出經營洮、河地區的方案，並以招納沿邊武裝、設站置寨和軍事推進配合，逐步取代一次遠征式的冒險行動。第二層是王韶在1072年前後取得熙州這個據點後，河州與岷、洮方向的堡寨成了下一階段目標；控制這些地方，才能把古渭寨的後勤基地與北方州治連接起來。第三層是木征所統諸部在河湟集兵、據守州治和山口，阻止宋軍把地方控制線向北延伸，雙方因而由零星邊寨衝突轉為有主攻方向的分進戰役。這不是兩個近代民族國家先後宣告作戰的全面戰爭，而是宋廷為取得州治、堡寨、道路與軍略縱深所發動的邊地戰爭；西夏是戰略背景，卻沒有可確證的軍隊直接進入本役戰場。
causeEn: The campaign had three connected causes. The first was Song’s northwestern strategy. Western Xia controlled the Hexi Corridor, while Song and the Tibetan tribal forces held overlapping positions in the Huangshui region. If the Song could establish a connected chain of forts between the upper Wei River, Guwei, and Hezhou, its forces could approach the Xia-controlled zone from the south and no longer depend on the narrow routes through Guanzhong. Early in the Xining era, Wang Shao proposed a sustained policy in the Tao and Hehuang regions, combining the enrollment of frontier military units, the establishment of posts and forts, and an advancing military operation instead of relying on a single risky expedition. The second cause was the acquisition of Xizhou around 1072. Once Xizhou was held, Hezhou and the forts toward Minzhou and Taozhou became the next objectives, because only their seizure could connect the Guwei supply base with the northern prefectural seats. The third was Muzheng’s concentration of forces in the Huangshui region and his occupation of prefectural sites and mountain approaches, which prevented Song from extending its line northward and turned scattered disputes over frontier posts into a campaign of coordinated advances. This was not a total war announced between two modern nation-states. It was a frontier war fought to obtain prefectural seats, forts, roads, and strategic depth. Western Xia formed the strategic background, but no Xia troops can be demonstrated as having entered the battlefield.
impact: 本役最直接的影響，是把零散而彼此間隔的邊寨控制，轉成古渭寨、熙州、河州、洮州與岷州之間可以互相接應的軍政線。宋廷在這些州治設官、留兵、修堡並配置後隊後，渭州方向不再只是向西探出的孤立突出部，而有了沿河谷向北延伸的補給與駐防體系。河湟一帶從此成為北宋可以向河西兩側施壓的基地，也使西夏的南部與東側方向多出一條宋軍通道，但尚不能因此說西夏已被包圍或遭到決定性打擊。行政上，宋朝恢復河、洮、岷等舊州名，並以安置司、州治官署和軍鎮一類機構逐步接管；這代表宋廷重新建立州級軍政權力，卻不表示每處已換成與關中完全相同的治理形式。政治上，木征在河州主戰失敗後，其號令範圍與所依賴的堡寨控制迅速崩解，最終走向正式歸順。限制同樣清楚：高山、谷道和被拉長的糧道使宋軍必須依賴連續堡寨，遠征主力只能階段投入，因而本役瓦解了木征的軍事抵抗，卻沒有在一天之內消除河湟全部武裝力量。
impactEn: The most immediate effect was the conversion of scattered and disconnected frontier posts into a mutually supporting military-administrative line running through Guwei, Xizhou, Hezhou, Taozhou, and Minzhou. Once Song officials, garrisons, repaired forts, and rear services were established at these prefectural seats, the Wei River position was no longer an isolated projection westward. It became the base of a supply and garrison system extending northward through the river valleys. The Huangshui region consequently gave the Northern Song a platform from which it could apply pressure along the southern and eastern approaches to Western Xia and could threaten routes leading toward the Hexi Corridor. It did not, however, mean that Xia had been encircled or decisively defeated. Administratively, the Song restored old prefectural names such as Hezhou, Taozhou, and Minzhou and gradually took control through pacification offices, prefectural agencies, and military posts. This re-established Song authority at the prefectural level, but it did not mean that every district immediately received the same institutions as Guanzhong. Politically, Muzheng’s defeat near Hezhou rapidly broke the cohesion of the forces and forts on which his authority depended and drove him toward formal submission. The limits were equally significant. High mountains, valley routes, and lengthening supply lines required Song to maintain a chain of forts and to feed its main forces in stages. The campaign destroyed Muzheng’s immediate military resistance, but it did not remove every armed force in the Huangshui region in a single operation.
result: 到熙寧六年歲末，戰役結果可以用具體據點說明：宋軍在河州方向取得主戰勝利，控制河州城與其外圍堡寨，又在夏秋間把洮州、岷州方向的州治和主要堡寨置於宋軍防線之下；熙州則早已成為南側支點。木征本人逃離戰場，未在1073年被擒，故這一年的結果是軍事上擊潰其主要抵抗、奪取州堡並切斷若干聯絡，而不是在戰場上生擒其首。宋廷奏報與後世史書用「收復河、岷等州」概括此役，重點是舊州治與軍政線重新回到宋朝控制之下，不是宣稱宋軍占有全部吐蕃地區。歲末的軍事畫面不再是一支大軍追逐潰敵，而是新城門重新編入守軍、堡牆修補、驛路接通、軍糧與弩矢分屯各堡，驛騎把戰報送往京城。這個結果為北宋此後長期維持河湟堡寨提供了根據，也迫使木征在翌年正式歸順；然而史料不足以證明宋軍全殲吐蕃軍，更不能把西夏的挫敗算作本役的直接戰果。
resultEn: By the end of Xining 6, the result can be stated in terms of concrete positions. Song forces won the principal engagement in the Hezhou direction, occupied Hezhou city and its surrounding forts, and during the summer and autumn brought the prefectural seats and principal strongholds toward Taozhou and Minzhou under Song control. Xizhou had already served as the southern anchor. Muzheng escaped the battlefield and was not captured in 1073. The result of that year was therefore the defeat of his principal resistance, the seizure of prefectural and fortified sites, and the breaking of several lines of communication, rather than the capture of his person. Song court dispatches and later histories summarized the campaign as the recovery of Hezhou, Minzhou, and the other prefectures. The term referred to the restoration of Song authority over old prefectural seats and military lines, not to the claim that the Song possessed the whole Tibetan region. The military scene at the year’s end no longer showed one mass army pursuing a routed enemy. Instead, new city gates were returned to garrison control, walls were repaired, courier roads were connected, grain and crossbow bolts were distributed among the forts, and mounted couriers carried reports to the capital. This outcome gave the Song a basis for maintaining a long-term fortified presence in the Huangshui region and forced Muzheng toward formal submission in the following year. The surviving evidence does not support a claim that the Song annihilated the Tibetan forces, and Western Xia’s position cannot be counted as a direct defeat inflicted in this campaign.
